name: Art and jewelry appraiser

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Vera and Ines (appraiser and front desk)

services.name: Studio appraisal, one item
services.story: The main story: one painting at the studio, $35. A card is saved for the $20 fee; Alex pays the $35 at the front desk at the visit.

services.name: Video appraisal, one item
services.story: A video appraisal of one item, $55, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Estate collection, at the studio
services.story: An estate collection at the studio: a $40 deposit when booking, the $100 rest at the desk when the report is picked up.

services.name: Collection quote from photos
services.story: A collection quoted from photos: a $20 deposit once the quote is OK'd; the rest is billed when the report is sent.

services.name: Quote from photos, free
services.story: A quote from photos, free: nothing taken, nothing charged.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Home appraisal, up to 5 items
services.story: The main story: a home appraisal of up to 5 items, $179 with the travel fee. A card is saved for the $89 fee; Rosie texts the bill after the visit.

services.name: Estate collection at home
services.story: An estate collection at home: $150, a $40 deposit when booking, the $110 rest charged to the saved card at DONE.

services.name: One item at a home
services.story: One item at a home, $75, paid in full when booking.

services_shape: appraisal visits at the studio (flow A) and at the customer's place (flow B); a video or photo appraisal counts as flow A
questions_before_times: What items: art, jewelry, silver, or a mix? And how many?
Why the appraisal: insurance, an estate, a sale, a donation, or the owner's own record?
Any photos of the items, with the marks, signatures or labels?
At the studio, at the customer's place, or by video?
safety_stop: someone hurt, or a fire or smoke at the place (call 911)
license: No state license for appraising art or jewelry in most places. Where a state or city asks for an appraiser's registration or certificate, or the business's own, the owner names it: shown as given, never checked by Rosie.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
